title: Quantum-to-classical correspondence in Krylov complexity
summary: We study quantum-to-classical correspondence of the Krylov space for evolutions driven by unitary maps with a classical limit. This entails a proper definition of corresponding quantum and classical operators, inner products and initial states. We prove that with these definitions the purely classical Krylov space is indeed obtained as the asymptotic $\hbar\to 0$ expansion of the quantum Krylov space, and provide several examples of such correspondence.
